```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
options(java.parameters = "-Xmx8G")
library(r5r)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r build-network}
r5r_core <- r5r::build_network(data_path = "D:/Final-Project/DATA")
```

```{r load-data}
schools_sf <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/schools_sf.rds") %>%
  st_transform(4326)

destinations <- schools_sf %>%
  mutate(
    id  = as.character(roll_number),
    lon = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
    lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(id, lon, lat, places) %>%
  filter(
    lon > -9.15, lon < -8.90,
    lat > 53.20, lat < 53.35
  )

cat("Galway schools:", nrow(destinations), "\n")
```

```{r origin}
origin <- data.frame(
  id  = "origin",
  lon = -9.0489,
  lat = 53.2743
)
```

```{r routes}
routes <- r5r::detailed_itineraries(
  r5r_network   = r5r_core,
  origins       = origin,
  destinations  = destinations,
  mode          = "WALK",
  max_walk_time = 30,
  verbose       = FALSE
)
cat("Routes returned:", nrow(routes), "\n")
```

```{r map}
routes_sf <- routes %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  filter(mode == "WALK")

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

  addPolylines(
    data    = routes_sf,
    color   = "#2980b9",
    weight  = 2,
    opacity = 0.6,
    label   = ~paste0(round(total_duration, 1), " min walk")
  ) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(
    data        = schools_sf %>%
                  filter(as.character(roll_number) %in% destinations$id),
    radius      = 6,
    color       = "#9f1f55",
    fillColor   = "#9f1f55",
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    stroke      = FALSE,
    popup       = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>Places: ", places)
  ) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(
    lng         = -9.0489,
    lat         = 53.2743,
    radius      = 10,
    color       = "black",
    fillColor   = "yellow",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    popup       = "Origin — CSA centroid"
  ) %>%

  addLegend(
    colors   = c("yellow", "#9f1f55", "#2980b9"),
    labels   = c("Origin (CSA centroid)", "Schools", "Walking route"),
    title    = "Walking accessibility",
    position = "bottomright"
  ) %>%

  setView(lng = -9.0489, lat = 53.2743, zoom = 14)
```

```{r map}
routes_sf <- routes %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  filter(mode == "WALK")

pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#2ca25f", "#fed976", "#fd8d3c"),
  domain  = routes_sf$total_duration
)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

  addPolylines(
    data    = routes_sf,
    color   = ~pal(total_duration),
    weight  = 3,
    opacity = 0.9,
    label   = ~paste0(round(total_duration, 1), " min walk"),
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight  = 5,
      opacity = 1,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(
    data        = schools_sf %>%
                  filter(as.character(roll_number) %in% destinations$id),
    radius      = 6,
    color       = "#9f1f55",
    fillColor   = "#9f1f55",
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    stroke      = FALSE,
    popup       = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>Places: ", places)
  ) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(
    lng         = -9.0489,
    lat         = 53.2743,
    radius      = 10,
    color       = "black",
    fillColor   = "yellow",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    popup       = "Origin — CSA centroid"
  ) %>%

  addLegend(
    pal      = pal,
    values   = routes_sf$total_duration,
    title    = "Walking time (min)",
    position = "bottomright"
  ) %>%

  setView(lng = -9.0489, lat = 53.2743, zoom = 14)
```

```{r stop-r5r}
r5r::stop_r5(r5r_core)
```
